Consolidation.

Consolidation is how Memory Vault keeps what it knows about you clean — merging duplicates, resolving contradictions, and letting stale detail fade. It runs on this device and never leaves it.

1

Consolidate automatically

When this is on, Memory Vault reviews your memories on a schedule and cleans them up. Near-duplicates get merged into one. Facts that contradict each other are resolved in favour of the newer one. Older memories you never use are archived out of everyday recall — never deleted. All of it happens on this device.

2

When it runs

Pick how often and what time. Choose a time your computer is usually on but you're not using it — the middle of the night is ideal, since a tidy-up uses real processing power for a few minutes. If your computer is asleep or off at that time, it catches up next time you open the app.

3

Run one now

Runs a consolidation immediately instead of waiting for the schedule. Useful right after you've added a lot of memories. If one of your AI agents is connected and using the vault, this waits and runs later rather than interrupting it.

Consolidation runs even when this window is closed. On a laptop that was asleep at the scheduled time, it catches up the next time you open the app.

Settings.
Your memories

Everything you keep is stored on this device and encrypted. It stays on this device even if you uninstall Memory Vault — uninstalling removes the app, not your memories. You can always find them here:

To remove them for good, use the button below. This is the only action that erases your memories.

This permanently deletes every memory in your vault. It cannot be undone, and it cannot be recovered from a copy of your data folder — the encryption key is destroyed, so what remains on disk becomes unreadable to everyone, including us.

If something goes wrong

Memory Vault keeps a private activity record on this device — what it did and when, and any errors it ran into. It records none of your memories, and it is never sent anywhere on its own.

If you hit a problem, save a copy and send it to us. It helps us find the fault without ever seeing what you keep.
